title: I Married a Stranger to Keep My Inheritance
description: To secure her inheritance, Evelyn marries a stranger who turns out to be a billionaire — and a far more protective husband than she expected. A roughly 73-minute YouTube upload with over 3.4 million views since its August 2026 release.
